 Follow us on Facebook Twitter Hello Latest news The Social Security Administration will begin payments corresponding to November starting on Friday, October 30.
 Kevin Dietsch U.S. benefits Who gets a Supplemental Security Income payment on Friday, Oct. 30?
 William Allen Greg Heilman Update: Oct 28th, 2026 08:51 EDT 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google The Social Security Administration (SSA) staggers the disbursement of payments to the various groups of recipients throughout each month. According to the U.S. agency’s official schedule , payments corresponding to November 2026 will begin on Friday, October 30 with the first of its five payment runs , as it sends out benefits for the following programs:
 Social Security ( retirement, disability and survivor ) 
 Supplemental Security Income (SSI) 
 November’s three-Wednesdays Social Security cycle:
 Of the just over 71.6 million Social Security beneficiaries in the U.S., many are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday in each month . These recipients’ payment day is decided by their date of birth.
 In November, this three-Wednesdays cycle kicks off on Tuesday the 10th as the 11th is a public holiday, Veterans’ Day. These are the distribution dates for those based on birth date:
 Born on 1st-10th of any month: Social Security paid out on Tuesday, November 10 
 Born on 11th-20th of any month: Social Security paid out on Wednesday, November 18 
 Born on 21st-31st of any month: Social Security paid out on Wednesday, November 25 
 NB: If you claim Social Security based on someone else’s employment history, the SSA refers to the other person’s birthday .
 What other payment dates does the SSA have in November?
 The SSA’s benefits schedule features two payment dates that are not birthday-dependent .
 October 30: SSI recipients 
 Beneficiaries of the SSI program will be paid on Friday, October 30 . A benefit for low-income, low resource individuals who are over the age of 65 or have a disability, SSI is worth a monthly average of $735.86, per the SSA.
 A scheme with 7.3 million recipients, SSI is separate to the Social Security program . Unlike Social Security, whose claimants must earn work credits to qualify, eligibility for SSI does not depend on an applicant’s employment record.
 November 3: Double beneficiaries/certain long-term Social Security recipients 
 On Tuesday, November 3, the SSA will send out Social Security money to beneficiaries who began receiving their monthly payments before May 1997 . November 3 will also be this month’s Social Security distribution date for recipients who claim SSI at the same time as Social Security benefit .
 SSI recipients above are normally paid later, on the first of the month, but distribution was brought forward as November 1 was a non-business day .
 How much are Social Security benefits?
 Retirement: $2,034.54 
 Disability: $1,499.41 
 Survivor: $1,636.31 
 ( Average monthly benefit , per the latest figures shared by the SSA .)
 COLA announced: how much is it?
 On October 14, the SSA confirmed that Social Security and SSI benefits will increase by 3.6% from January , in the agency’s latest annual cost-of-living adjustment (COLA). The largest hike of its kind in four years, the 2027 COLA translates into a monthly increase of around $70 on the current average Social Security payment.
 How does the Social Security Admin pay benefits?
 Benefits can be paid into a Social Security or SSI beneficiary’s bank account by direct deposit 
 Money can be loaded onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for federal disbursements
